title: Give thanks

lines.text: Give thanks, with a grateful heart.
Give thanks to the Holy One.
And now let the weak say "I am strong",
Let the poor say "I am rich",
Because of what the Lord has done for us.

chords:
[Chorus]
[F]Give thanks, with a [C]grateful heart.
Give [Dm]thanks to the [Am]Holy One.
Give [Bb]thanks because He's [F]given
[Eb]Jesus Christ, His [C]Son.
(Repeat)

[Verse 1]
And [Am]now let the [Dm]weak say "I am [Gm]strong",
Let the [C]poor say "I am [Am]rich",
Because of [Dm]what the Lord has [Eb]done for [C]us.
(Repeat)

[Chorus]
[F]Give thanks (last time)
